sources.excerpt: Black Fuzz Phrase LTD by Jam Pedals | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Jam Pedals Black Fuzz Phrase LTD LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS FUZZ Description Black Fuzz Phrase LTD Limited Edition Germanium Fuzz featuring NOS OC44 Philips Black Glass Transistors Produced in small batches – availability is regularly updated. Built entirely by hand in Athens, Greece, the Black Fuzz Phrase LTD is a love letter to the raw, expressive fuzz tones of the late ’60s. At its core lies an ultra-rare stash of NOS OC44 Philips black glass transistors, manufactured in 1969 and individually tested and matched by ear. These legendary components are prized for their exceptionally low leakage, musical gain, and quiet operation—ideal for crafting a fuzz circuit that’s both aggressive and articulate. sources.excerpt: Jam Pedals Black Fuzz Phrase LTD Skip to content Free shipping on $50 Shop Search for: Search Search Main Menu Search for: Search Search Shop Sale! Home  /  Effects & Pedals - Fuzz  / Jam Pedals Black Fuzz Phrase LTD Effects & Pedals - Fuzz Jam Pedals Black Fuzz Phrase LTD $ 599.00 Original price was: $599.00. $ 119.80 Current price is: $119.80. & Free Shipping Jam Pedals Black Fuzz Phrase LTD quantity Add to cart SKU: 210000086476 Category: Effects & Pedals - Fuzz Tag: JAM Pedals Guaranteed Safe Checkout Description From Jam Pedals: Built entirely by hand in Athens, Greece, the Black Fuzz Phrase LTD is a love letter to the raw, expressive fuzz tones of the late ’60s. At its core lies an ultra-rare stash of NOS OC44 Philips black glass transistors, manufactured in 1969 and individually tested and matched by ear. These legendary components are prized for their exceptionally low leakage, musical gain, and quiet operation—ideal for crafting a fuzz circuit that’s both aggressive and articulate. Each unit is point-to-point hand-wired on a turret board and wrapped in luxurious suede, staying true to our tradition of uncompromising craftsmanship. With vintage-spec carbon-comp resistors and tropical fish capacitors throughout the signal path, this fuzz responds musically to your playing and cleans up beautifully with your guitar’s volume knob. Thanks to the remarkable stability of the OC44s, the internal bias is factory-set to 4.5V—no tweaking needed, just plug in and go. From wooly chords to singing leads, the Black Fuzz Phrase LTD delivers rich harmonics, smooth sustain, and that unmistakable vintage rasp. • Hand-wired, point-to-point construction • Individually ear-matched NOS OC44 black glass transistors • Vintage-spec components for authentic tone and feel • True bypass switching • Positive ground circuit – use with isolated power supplies only A true collector’s piece designed to inspire from the first note.
